[[File:Dasha_Sigweed.png|thumb|right|160px|[[Dasha Sigweed (poster)/Legends|A poster]] promoting Dasha Sigweed, sharing the space with a [[Handmaiden pin-up/Legends|handmaiden pin-up]].]]
'''Dasha Sigweed''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] singer and DJ living during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were known for their loud, rhythmic leap-jump style.<ref name="Slug" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dasha Sigweed's name is a play on the name of the European DJ duo [[Wikipedia:Sasha & John Digweed|Sasha & John Digweed]].<ref name="SWArchive">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode211.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lightsaber Lost|date=2010-01-22|quote=Among the Aurebesh signs spotted around Coruscant are Star Tours posters suggesting trips to Glee Anselm, a distinctive "SODA" advertisement, a poster for a musical act called Stargazer and a performer named "Dasha Sigweed" (an anagram of '''[[Wikipedia:Sasha & John Digweed}}</ref> In ''[[Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]'', a [[2013]] article written by [[Edward M. Erdelac]] for the official [[StarWars.com]] blog, the character was mistakenly referred to as "Sasha Digweed."<ref name="Slug" />
